`abstract class Asset`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`ClasspathAsset`](/reference/resources/classpathasset/), [`FileAsset`](/reference/resources/fileasset/), [`StreamAsset`](/reference/resources/streamasset/), [`UrlAsset`](/reference/resources/urlasset/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.asset` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Asset.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/asset/Asset.java)

Where the bytes of a resource, a font, a shader or a model come from, a file, the classpath, a URL or a stream, behind one stable id.

## Description

Every loader of JOID takes an `Object` and turns it into an asset with `Asset.of(...)`: a `String` path or URL, a `File`, an `InputStream`, or an asset you build yourself.
The unique id keys the caches, so two loads of the same asset share their data.

## Creation details

<a id="Asset-factory-of"></a>

### of

`Asset of(Object handle)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns `handle` when it is already an asset, otherwise the asset that the registered [`AssetLocator`](/reference/resources/assetlocator/) list finds for it.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when no locator supports `handle`, or when a path is found neither in the classpath nor as a file.

<a id="Asset-constructor"></a>

### Asset

`Asset(String uniqueId)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates an asset with the id that keys its caches; two assets with the same id are the same content.

## Method details

<a id="Asset-method-getFile"></a>

### getFile

`File getFile()` 

Returns the file on disk that holds the asset, or `null` when it is not a plain file, such as a resource inside a jar or a URL; a video reads such an asset through a copy in the cache folder.

<a id="Asset-method-isRemote"></a>

### isRemote

`boolean isRemote()` 

If `true`, opening the asset goes through the network, so JOID reads it on a background thread.
`false` by default.

<a id="Asset-method-peek"></a>

### peek

`byte[] peek(int length)` 

**Throws:**

- `UncheckedIOException`: The start of … cannot be read

Returns the first `length` bytes of the asset, fewer when it is shorter; the formats use them to recognize a file.
Throws `UncheckedIOException` when the asset cannot be read.

<a id="Asset-method-read"></a>

### read

`byte[] read()` 

Returns the whole content of the asset.
Throws `IOException` when it cannot be read.

<a id="Asset-method-toString"></a>

### toString

`String toString()` 

Returns the class and the id of the asset, for logs.

<a id="Asset-method-getUniqueId"></a>

### getUniqueId

`String getUniqueId()` 

Returns the id that keys the caches of this asset.

<a id="Asset-method-open"></a>

### open

`InputStream open()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns a new stream on the content, which the caller closes; JOID calls it each time it reads the asset, possibly from a background thread.
Throw `IOException` when the content cannot be opened.
